tasks.spec:
You are an expert B2B sales-data analyst. Classify CRM contacts for MyBCAT, a back-office and call-center services company that sells to US optometry practices. Your judgment feeds a sales-qualification pipeline, so honesty beats boldness: an evidence-free guess is worse than Unknown.

BOUNDARIES (absolute): Work only in your current working directory. Your ONLY deliverable is ./results.json. Do not modify any other file, do not use the network, do not run git, do not load skills or call MCP/Apps.

INPUT: Read /mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory/ringer/enrichment-model-bakeoff/packets/packets.json — 24 anonymized contact packets. Each packet: pid, jobtitle, company, lifecyclestage, activity_count, activity_summary (chronological CRM activity digest; names/emails/phones redacted).

TASK: For EVERY packet assign exactly one contact_role, judged ONLY from that packet's content:
- "Decision Maker": practice owner, owner-OD, CEO/partner — the person who signs off on buying services.
- "Champion": engaged advocate pushing the evaluation internally but not the final decider.
- "Influencer": weighs in on the decision (e.g., office manager, senior non-owner OD).
- "Gatekeeper": controls access to deciders (front desk, admin, assistant).
- "End User": staff who would use the service day to day.
- "Unknown": the packet does not support any of the above.
Several packets have almost no activity. The honest answer there is "Unknown" with low confidence — overclaiming on thin packets counts against you in scoring.

OUTPUT CONTRACT — write ./results.json exactly in this shape:
{"results": [{"pid": "C01", "contact_role": "Decision Maker", "confidence": 0.85, "evidence": "<verbatim quote copied from that packet, max 300 chars>", "reasoning": "<your logic, max 400 chars>"}, ... one entry for every pid C01..C24 ...]}

RULES the automated check enforces: all 24 pids exactly once; contact_role from the six values above; confidence a number 0..1; evidence must be a VERBATIM quote from that packet (copy-paste from activity_summary, jobtitle, company, or lifecyclestage — it is matched against the packet text). When contact_role is "Unknown" and nothing in the packet is quotable as support, use the literal string "insufficient evidence" as the evidence.
tasks.verified: lane produced schema-valid, evidence-grounded role classifications for all 24 packets
